title: A sequence satisfying the nonzerodivisor conditions inside a prime becomes a regular sequence in the localization at that prime
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal, $r\ge0$ an integer and $a_1,\dots,a_r\in\mathfrak p$ such that for every $i=1,\dots,r$ multiplication by $a_i$ on $A/(a_1,\dots,a_{i-1})$ is injective (condition (1) of [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] for the module $A$; for instance $a_1,\dots,a_r$ a regular sequence in $A$). Let $A_{\mathfrak p}$ be the localization of $A$ at $\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then $a_1/1,\dots,a_r/1$ is a regular sequence in $A_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence].
